name: Settings Shell And Navigation
summary: Core settings shell metadata for the shared MainWindow experience, including the runtime NavigationView swap between production routes and settings routes, built-in settings-item toggle behavior, back navigation inside settings hubs, placeholder control usage, compatibility host plumbing for existing settings pages, and the Core navigation cards that route to shared configuration pages such as the Material Availability field settings page.

userActions: Use the built-in Settings item as a Return toggle while settings mode is active
Open the Material Availability field settings page from the Core hub
Return to the originating module's default route after leaving settings mode
Use the built-in back button to return to the active module hub
Understand which navigation actions are available
See placeholders for unfinished settings pages
preserveRules: Keep settings-page construction resolved through the service provider
Keep existing settings pages working through the shared host abstraction whether they are embedded or shown in a dedicated window
Keep direct Core hub card navigation resolved through the service provider
Keep step and visible-step replacement preserving the current pagination semantics
validationHints: Confirm the MainWindow navigation items swap between production routes and settings routes when the built-in Settings item is clicked
Confirm the built-in Settings item text changes to Return while settings mode is active
Confirm leaving Receiving or Dunnage for settings prompts before unsaved work is cleared
Confirm leaving settings returns to the originating module's default route
Confirm navigation buttons still page correctly
Confirm visible steps still match the current button page after whole-collection replacement
Confirm the new Material Availability card opens the dedicated settings page and updates the shell header
Confirm the built-in back button returns to the selected module hub when a child page is active
Confirm the shell still hosts the selected settings page correctly
